capabilities.name: claude_stage
capabilities.description: Run a Claude prompt as a pipeline stage. Renders prompt_template with str.format_map(ctx) and returns the model's text response. Auto-selects between the anthropic SDK and the `claude -p` CLI fallback.
capabilities.when_to_use: Reasoning, planning, structured generation, summarization, content drafting, or any step that benefits from Claude's strengths.

params.name: prompt_template
params.description: Format string referencing ctx keys as {key}

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds before the call is abandoned

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Max tokens in the response (SDK backend only)

capabilities.name: openai_stage
capabilities.description: Run an OpenAI chat completion as a pipeline stage. Returns the assistant message text. Requires `pip install stagehand[openai]` and OPENAI_API_KEY.
capabilities.when_to_use: When OpenAI models are preferred for cost, latency, or capability reasons (e.g. structured JSON via response_format on supported models).

params.name: prompt_template
params.description: Format string referencing ctx keys as {key}

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds before the call is abandoned

capabilities.name: gemini_stage
capabilities.description: Run a Gemini generate_content call as a pipeline stage. Returns the model's text response. Requires `pip install stagehand[gemini]` and GEMINI_API_KEY.
capabilities.when_to_use: When Gemini models are preferred (e.g. long-context tasks on gemini-1.5-pro, multimodal inputs, or cost on gemini-2.0-flash).

params.name: prompt_template
params.description: Format string referencing ctx keys as {key}

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds before the call is abandoned

capabilities.name: http_stage
capabilities.description: Make an HTTP request as a pipeline stage using urllib.request from stdlib. Returns parsed JSON when expect_json is true and the response is JSON, otherwise raw text. URL and body templates support {ctx_key} substitution.
capabilities.when_to_use: Calling external APIs (REST), webhooks, fetching pages, or any I/O that does not warrant a custom Python stage.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds before the request is abandoned

params.name: expect_json
params.description: Parse response as JSON if true
